item.description: The backstop from Nvidia would ‌help the ChatGPT maker lease a 10-gigawatt project that SoftBank’s energy subsidiary is developing in southern Ohio, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Digital Economy: A new frontier for Bangladesh–US business relations
item.description: The key to sustaining this partnership lies in human capital development. The successful adoption of AI requires a workforce equipped with advanced digital skills rather than only basic programming knowledge.

item.title: UNICEF ranks Bangladesh among highest climate-risk nations for children

item.title: “Earning 10,000 patients’ trust within a year is our greatest achievement”
item.description: “In just one year, people have recognised our service, connected with our approach, and placed their trust in us. Over the past year, more than 10,000 people have sought care at our hospital, and we hope every one of them left in better health and spirits.”

item.description: French authorities ordered the total evacuation of the Cap Ferret peninsula, a tourism hotspot on its Atlantic Coast.

item.description: Kim Yong-beom, the president’s policy adviser, told ​reporters on Thursday that the companies ​would unveil long-term memory chip supply contracts ⁠with global technology partners.

item.title: Substitute Torres rescues grim final to make Spain world champions
item.description: Spain, masters of the suffocating, pressing style, had nothing to press, nothing to suffocate. The Argentines were the first-ever team to fail to muster one ​shot — on target or off — for the entire 90 minutes of a World Cup final.

item.title: Bangladesh crowned unbeaten champions in Women’s Junior AHF Cup
item.description: Bangladesh clinched the title with a 2-0 victory over Kazakhstan in the final, displaying remarkable skill, discipline, confidence and fighting spirit throughout the tournament.

item.title: Saka’s hat trick lifts England past France 6-4 in wild third-place game
item.description: England and France delivered a thriller in a World Cup match that was supposed to be an afterthought.

item.title: Kylian Mbappé passes Lionel Messi for career World Cup scoring record with 22 goals
item.description: Mbappé finished this World Cup with 10 goals, two more than Messi in the race for the Golden Boot, which is awarded to the tournament’s top scorer.

item.title: “Severity of climate change’s impacts depends on urban planning, disaster preparedness”
item.description: “The current situation results from both climate change and urban disaster management deficiencies. While climate change serves as a significant trigger, the severity of its impacts largely depends on urban planning, infrastructure management and disaster preparedness.”

item.title: Defending champion Argentina reaches World Cup final by beating England 2-1
item.description: Trailing 1-0 going into the 85th minute, Argentina rallied for a 2-1 victory over England with goals from Enzo Fernandez and substitute Lautaro Martinez.

item.title: Spain shuts down France and Kylian Mbappé, advances to the World Cup final with a 2-0 victory
item.description: “We were up against one of the best national teams in the world, but today, they were facing the best team in the world,” Spain coach Luis de la Fuente said.

item.title: “Technology alone isn’t enough, we need to improve the process and the people too”
item.description: “To make cybersecurity tools truly effective, we need mature processes and capable people who can operate, govern, monitor and continuously improve the technology. The real value of technology comes when people and processes are able to drive it efficiently.”

item.title: “Cyber education and capability development should be absolute priorities for digital security”
item.description: “Once the general public is aware, they can make informed decisions. Otherwise, no matter what tools are brought in, if people are untrained, they will still click on spam and fall for scams. So, cyber education and capability development are absolute priorities.”
